dedupe_keys.name: rebase energy restructuring of nve norwegian wind power data

description: Rebase Energy publishes a CSV restructuring of wind-power data from the Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate, NVE. The dataset card identifies three files: wind-park metadata, extended metadata for individual turbines and hourly generation time series for each wind park. It also links an interactive map. Coverage is Norwegian wind installations, but the public card does not establish the complete park count, field units or observation period; the more specific counts in the curated list were not adopted. Files are publicly listed without a stated fee. The card labels its licence as other without naming terms, while the linked NVE page permits attributed use when content is presented unchanged. A limitation is that this condition does not establish permission for every transformed or redistributed derivative. Source revision dates also do not prove that the mirror is current. Simulation uses include wind-generation calibration and linking turbine metadata to park outputs, subject to clarifying reuse rights. No related catalogue or first-review record for this restructuring was identified. Documentation and file metadata were inspected without downloading the CSV files.
licence: Other, unspecified in dataset card; NVE source permits unchanged attributed reuse
